_doc: Lineup-flagged games AWAITING school evidence. A machine signal (lineup rows fitting the opposite roster) may CORROBORATE but never quarantine or correct alone -- so a flagged final whose schools have not posted yet sits here, counted as the feed says, until the schools decide. Every entry carries recheck_by; test_lineup_attribution accepts a pending gid ONLY until that date, so an entry cannot rot into permanent silence. Resolution: file a result_corrections entry (confirmed inversion), or an attribution_adjudications label confirmed_correct (false alarm), then delete the entry here.
